Facts used:
- Harrowfield’s 2025 household water use was 7,146 megalitres, and its 2025 population was 90,212 residents. [NR-07]
- Ossbridge’s 2025 household water use was 3,862 megalitres, and its 2025 population was 52,904 residents. [NR-01]
- The 2025 household water tariff was 142.35 tenge per cubic metre. [NR-15]
- One megalitre equals 1,000 cubic metres. [NR-15]

Calculations:
- Harrowfield water per resident = 7,146 × 1,000 ÷ 90,212 = 79.201878... cubic metres.
- Harrowfield cost per resident = 79.201878... × 142.35 = 11,272.881... tenge.
- Ossbridge water per resident = 3,862 × 1,000 ÷ 52,904 = 72.998... cubic metres.
- Ossbridge cost per resident = 72.998... × 142.35 = 10,391.2... tenge.
- Difference = 11,272.881... − 10,391.2... = 881.681... tenge per resident.
- Therefore, Harrowfield households paid more.

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 881.681
